title.zh: Max 导师 GPT-Live 实时语音与独立 5/15 分钟额度
title.en: Max tutor GPT-Live voice with independent 5/15-minute allowance

purpose.zh: 以更自然、可打断的 GPT-Live 双向语音配合 GPT-6 Luna 教学后端，并将昂贵语音与文字练习分开计时，控制试用及付费成本而不压缩文字学习。
purpose.en: Use natural interruptible GPT-Live speech with a GPT-6 Luna teaching backend and separate costly voice time from text practice, controlling trial and paid costs without shortening text learning.

zh: Max 一对一虚拟人物语音切换到 GPT-Live WebRTC；GPT-6 Luna 作为委派教学模型，保留学习语言、辅助站点语言及简短回答偏好。
试用会员每日实时语音 5 分钟、付费会员 15 分钟；文字导师继续保留每日 10/30 分钟，与语音互不扣减。
只显示 AI 导师的可滚动语音字幕，不生成学生实时字幕；结束时由服务器确认提供方会话关闭，失败时不释放活动通话。
en: Move the Max one-to-one avatar voice to GPT-Live WebRTC with GPT-6 Luna delegation, retaining learning/support languages and concise-answer preferences.
Allow five live voice minutes per trial day or fifteen per paid day while retaining separate 10/30-minute text tutor practice.
Display scrollable AI-tutor speech captions only, without learner live captions; confirm provider session closure server-side before releasing an active call.

zh: Max 一对一 AI 导师、实时语音网关、使用量接口及 D1 通话计时；订阅价格和支付不变。
en: Max one-to-one tutor, live voice gateway, usage API and D1 call accounting; subscription pricing and checkout are unchanged.

zh: 沿用 SmartLingo 已验证的 Max 会话、单活动通话、虚拟人物画面、按分钟清理与审计网关；仅按 GPT-Live 不兼容的新会话、事件与服务端附加 WebSocket 协议适配。
D1 迁移为新通话标记独立语音额度，旧 Realtime 通话继续按旧规则返还文字预留时长；失败的新连接绝不返还无关的文字时长。
实时语音按已关闭通话计时，连接初始化按至少 15 秒计入；浏览器限时关闭、服务端心跳与分钟清理作为多层保护。
en: Reuse verified SmartLingo Max sessions, one-active-call gating, avatar, minute cleanup and audited gateway; adapt only the incompatible GPT-Live session, event and server-side attached-WebSocket contracts.
A D1 migration marks new calls with independent voice accounting, preserves legacy Realtime text-reservation refunds and prevents failed new connections from refunding unrelated text time.
Account closed-call time with a 15-second minimum for Live initialization; browser deadline, server heartbeat and minute cleanup provide layered controls.

zh: TypeScript、零警告 lint、完整本地测试、生产构建、D1 重放及共享站点门禁。
发布后核对真实 Chrome 普通 QA 用户的可用额度、连接、导师语音字幕、结束与重连，并核对 Project 精确发布记录。
en: TypeScript, zero-warning lint, full local tests, production build, D1 replay and shared-site gates.
After deployment, inspect a real ordinary-member Chrome QA session for allowance, connection, tutor speech captions, close and reconnect, then verify the exact Project release record.

zh: 不执行付款、长期并发语音负载或会员数据修改。GPT-Live 按通话时长计费，服务器定时清理最长可能在额度截止后约一分钟执行；实际成本须持续监测。
en: No payment, prolonged concurrent voice load or membership-data changes. GPT-Live bills by call duration; scheduled server cleanup may run up to about one minute after a deadline, so actual cost needs ongoing monitoring.

zh: 学习语言仍独立于站点辅助语言；动画虚拟人物不冒充真人视频，且仍不保存原始麦克风音频。
en: The learning language remains independent of the site support language; the animated avatar is not represented as human video, and raw microphone audio is not stored.

rollback.zh: 如需回退，先停止新 GPT-Live 通话再部署前一版代码；D1 新列保留兼容，旧 Realtime 通话仍按共享文字额度计时与返还。
rollback.en: To roll back, stop new GPT-Live calls before deploying the prior code; the additive D1 column stays compatible and legacy Realtime calls retain shared-text accounting and refunds.
